title: Guest Meal Terms across the Employee Meal Account Plans
content:
An employee may bring a guest to the counter and ring that guest's meal on their own Employee Meal Account wherever the plan allows it. Three figures govern it, and they are printed against each of the six meal plans.

| Meal plan | Guest meal allowed on the account | Surcharge added to each guest meal | Guest meals the plan allows in one calendar month |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | no | $0.00 | 0 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | yes | $4.50 | 4 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | yes | $4.50 | 4 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | yes | $5.25 | 2 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | no | $0.00 | 0 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | yes | $12.00 | 20 |

## The three figures, stated

The first column says whether the employee may ring a guest meal on the account at all. The second is the surcharge added to each guest meal. The third is the number of guest meals the plan allows in one calendar month, as a whole number.

## Basis Q&A

**On which plans is a guest meal offered at all?** On four of the six: the Prepaid Declining Balance Account, the Payroll Deduction Meal Account, the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account and the Executive Dining Charge Account. The Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account and the Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account print no guest meal entitlement, and against both the surcharge is $0.00 and the monthly allowance is 0.

**What surcharge does a guest meal carry?** $4.50 on the Prepaid Declining Balance Account and on the Payroll Deduction Meal Account, $5.25 on the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account, and $12.00 on the Executive Dining Charge Account.

**How many guest meals does a calendar month allow?** 4 on the Prepaid Declining Balance Account and on the Payroll Deduction Meal Account, 2 on the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account, and 20 on the Executive Dining Charge Account.
